text:
I have handed out

clandestine leaflets

shouting

long live freedom!

in the middle of the street

defying the

armed guards

I took part in the

April rebellion

but I turn pale

when I pass your house

and your mere glance

translation.title: Epigram XXXVI
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the poem's contrast between public bravery and the beloved's disarming glance.
